title: How is MatPat connected to Napoleon?
description:
Congress, a president, two queens and two paintings link MatPat to Napoleon.

MatPat → Yvette Clarke → Nancy Pelosi → Barack Obama → Elizabeth II → Mary of Teck → Queen Victoria → Napoleon III → Napoleon

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. MatPat → Yvette Clarke: In 2025, MatPat spoke at the Capitol beside Congresswoman Yvette Clarke, launching a caucus for creators.
   Photo by Yvette Clarke, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Creator_Economy_Caucus_launch,_2025_(1).jpg
2. Yvette Clarke → Nancy Pelosi: In 2010, Clarke stood with Speaker Nancy Pelosi at a press event on the Capitol steps.
   Photo by Nancy Pelosi from San Francisco, CA, CC BY 2.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Speaker_Pelosi_and_Samuel_Obergh_(4444863968).jpg
3. Nancy Pelosi → Barack Obama: Also in 2010, Pelosi stood right behind Barack Obama as he signed his health care law.
   Photo by Pete Souza, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Obama_signs_health_care-20100323.jpg
4. Barack Obama → Queen Elizabeth II: In 2009, President Obama and Michelle met Queen Elizabeth the Second at Buckingham Palace.
   Photo by Pete Souza, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Barack_Obama_Michelle_Obama_Queen_Elizabeth_II_Buckingham_Palace_London.jpg
5. Queen Elizabeth II → Queen Mary: Back in 1939, a young Princess Elizabeth posed with her grandmother, Queen Mary.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Queen_Mary_with_Princess_Elizabeth_and_Margaret.jpg
6. Queen Mary → Queen Victoria: In 1895, Mary sat beside Queen Victoria at Balmoral, holding her baby son, the future Edward the Eighth.
   Photo by Robert Milne, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Queen_Victoria_with_family_members.jpg
7. Queen Victoria → Napoleon III: This painting shows Victoria in 1855, visiting Napoleon's tomb in Paris with Emperor Napoleon the Third.
   Photo by Edward Matthew Ward, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Edward_Matthew_Ward_(1816-79)_-_Queen_Victoria_at_the_Tomb_of_Napoleon,_24_August_1855_-_RCIN_402019_-_Royal_Collection.jpg
8. Napoleon III → Napoleon: And in this 1810 painting, the baby on Napoleon's knee is his nephew, the future Napoleon the Third.
   Photo by Jean Louis Ducis, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Napol%C3%A9on_enfants_Saint-Cloud.jpg

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

#matpat #napoleon #sixdegrees #history #didyouknow #shorts
